title: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking
abstract: arXiv:2610.42148v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision models such as Jev have emerged as a highly promising paradigm for LLM agent systems, providing lightweight and reliable categorical reasoning for rapid System One execution. However, existing generation-oriented inference engines fail to support these workloads effectively, suffering from severe prefix recomputation overheads or distorted output probabilities. To address this challenge, we propose Flide, an efficient and exact inference engine that decouples the logical tree structure of a decision request from its physical execution within a single flattened token stream. Through ForkAttention, Flide navigates request dependencies using GPU-resident indices across both standard attention and recurrent Gated DeltaNet layers, guaranteeing in exact arithmetic that every query branch evaluates identically to an isolated forward pass. translated_title: Flide：利用精确状态分叉加速决策推理
translated_abstract: 诸如 Jev 之类的决策模型已成为 LLM 智能体系统中极具前景的范式，能够为快速的系统一（System One）执行提供轻量且可靠的类别推理。然而，现有的面向生成的推理引擎无法有效支持这类工作负载，存在严重的前缀重计算开销或输出概率失真问题。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 Flide，一个高效且精确的推理引擎，它将决策请求的逻辑树结构与在单一扁平化 token 流中的物理执行解耦。通过 ForkAttention，Flide 借助驻留于 GPU 的索引，在标准注意力层和循环 Gated DeltaNet 层中导航请求间的依赖关系，并以精确算术保证每个查询分支的求值结果与隔离的前向传播完全一致。通过将分支拓扑直接表达为 GPU 驻留元数据，Flide 能够适应多样的请求……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Flide 是一种精确高效的决策推理引擎，通过 ForkAttention 在单一扁平化 token 流中实现精确的状态分叉，将决策请求的逻辑树结构与物理执行解耦，从而消除前缀重计算开销并保证分支求值结果与独立前向传播完全一致。
en_tdlr: Flide is an exact and efficient inference engine for decision models that decouples the logical tree structure of decision requests from physical execution via ForkAttention with GPU-resident state forking, eliminating prefix recomputation overhead while guaranteeing that every query branch evaluates identically to an isolated forward pass.
